old_problem: The row omitted transfer target, payload and bounds, but a scratch-only signed contract can parameterize the clear repeated-transfer purpose without guessing values.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits project-bound BMC behavior but forbids guessed OEM paths; ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-15 requires signed integrity/service limits, and ED-17 preserves SEL evidence. Execution stays gated until the scratch contract is approved.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row59 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3093 and actual next row60/history3094 were read.
Only an approved non-system scratch path with reserve/wear budget is permitted; arbitrary deletion and firmware partitions are excluded.
Deterministic payload/hash and explicit repetition or duration/rate create measurable bounded stress.
Per-iteration integrity, free-space and service health are correlated to low-rail/dew-point data; no action ran.

test_case.test_name: Bounded BMC scratch-file upload/remove at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Exercise the approved BMC transfer service and scratch storage under cold/low-rail margin without integrity, capacity, wear, service or platform failure.
required_package: BMC/storage identity and approved scratch path
Pinned authenticated protocol/account and deterministic payload/hash
Signed loop bound, reserve/wear and service limits
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/-5% conditions and execute the signed upload-hash-remove loop only through the approved account/protocol/scratch path while recording reserve and service health, then clean up, warm dry and restore nominal rails.
test_case.expected_result: Every authorized iteration preserves the hash, removes only its test object, remains within reserve/wear/service limits and leaves BMC storage/services healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved path, payload, bound and measurable integrity/service evidence; arbitrary data, unbounded loops or transport success alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Least privilege, non-sensitive payload and preserved SEL
Abort on low reserve, mismatch, service loss, storage/environment fault
No auto-retry; safe cleanup and dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop further writes, preserve evidence, remove only confirmed test objects if safe, restore nominal rails, warm/dry and use owner recovery if cleanup/service validation fails.
